title: Lead Copywriter
description:
Lead CopywriterAbout Zouk

Zouk is a 100% vegan, proudly Indian consumer brand specialising in bags, wallets and accessories. We are on a mission to build an iconic global consumer brand from India by delivering exceptional products and building a strong consumer brand team.

Our products are available across our website, leading marketplaces and a growing offline retail presence, reaching over 20 lakh customers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Lead Copywriter** to own the quality and consistency of how Zouk communicates with consumers across multiple touchpoints.

As a digital-first consumer brand, Zouk communicates with consumers every day across social media, performance marketing, CRM, website, product launches, campaigns and retail. The Lead Copywriter will ensure that this communication is sharp, distinctive, relevant and consistent with Zouk's brand voice.

The role will lead the copy team while remaining hands-on. You should be comfortable moving between a brand headline, social media copy, a performance marketing hook, a WhatsApp message, a product story and website copy, while understanding the objective behind each piece of communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

Brand Voice & Copy Quality

* Own and continuously strengthen Zouk's tone of voice across consumer touchpoints.
* Maintain consistency while adapting communication for different channels, audiences and objectives.
* Establish clear copy principles and messaging guidelines for the team.
* Review and improve important consumer-facing communication.
* Maintain a high standard of writing, clarity, tone and messaging across channels.

D2C, Performance Marketing & CRM

* Partner with D2C, Performance Marketing and Retention teams on consumer communication.
* Develop strong hooks, propositions, headlines and CTAs based on the communication objective and target consumer.
* Create copy that supports both brand building and conversion objectives.
* Use performance and consumer response to identify what messaging works and improve communication over time.
* Build reusable messaging frameworks and learnings across products, audiences and occasions.

Product, Website & Retail

* Own copy quality across product launches, website pages, landing pages and product detail pages.
* Translate product features into simple, relevant and compelling consumer benefits.
* Develop messaging for new products, categories, collections and key launches.
* Support copy requirements across marketplaces, packaging, stores, OOH and other offline touchpoints.
* Ensure product communication is clear, consistent and aligned with the brand voice.

Brand Campaigns

* Partner with Brand Marketing, Design and Content teams on key campaigns and brand initiatives.
* Translate campaign strategy into clear messaging, headlines and copy across formats.
* Ensure the core campaign thought is communicated consistently across digital, social, media and retail.
* Work with external creative partners when required while maintaining Zouk's tone of voice.

Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop the copy team.
* Own prioritisation, allocation and review of copy requirements across teams.
* Maintain high quality standards while operating at the speed and volume required by a growing D2C business.
* Work closely with Design, Content, Brand, D2C, Performance Marketing and Retention teams.

AI & Scale

* Use AI tools to improve research, ideation, content variations and turnaround times.
* Build templates, messaging libraries and workflows for recurring copy requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve team productivity without compromising quality or brand voice.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* Consistent and distinctive brand voice across consumer touchpoints.
* Stronger copy across D2C, performance marketing, CRM, social media and product communication.
* Improved effectiveness of messaging in driving consumer response and business objectives.
* Faster and higher-quality output from the copy team.
* Ability to maintain brand standards despite the pace and volume of a growing D2C business.
* Development of stronger writers within the team.
* Improved efficiency through better systems, templates and AI-enabled workflows.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for someone with **4–7 years of copywriting experience**, preferably within a D2C, consumer, fashion, lifestyle, beauty or e-commerce business.

D2C experience is strongly preferred.

**The ideal candidate should have:**

* Excellent writing and editing skills with a strong instinct for language.
* Experience writing across multiple consumer touchpoints rather than specialising in a single format.
* Ability to understand the consumer, context and objective before beginning to write.
* Exposure to performance marketing and CRM communication.
* Strong judgement on tone, simplicity, hierarchy and clarity.
* High ownership and comfort managing multiple priorities and quick turnarounds.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with designers, marketers and business teams.
* Comfort using data and consumer response to improve copy.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools as part of copywriting and content workflows.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience leading or mentoring a small copy team.
* Experience in fashion, beauty, lifestyle or another consumer category.
* Experience writing for websites, product detail pages and e-commerce journeys.
* Experience with product/category launches and retail communication.
* Experience working in a fast-paced D2C or consumer brand environment.

**What Makes Someone Exceptional in This Role?**

An exceptional Lead Copywriter understands that not every piece of communication needs to be a campaign idea.

They can identify the job a piece of communication needs to do and find the sharpest way to achieve it — whether that means building desire for a new product, explaining a functional benefit, stopping someone mid-scroll, making a WhatsApp message worth opening or finding the right line for an important brand moment.

They combine strong writing craft with consumer understanding, speed and judgement. They can personally produce excellent work, make other writers better and maintain a distinctive Zouk voice even when the team is producing communication at D2C scale.

**Why Join Zouk?**

This role offers the opportunity to shape how a rapidly growing Indian consumer brand communicates across the entire consumer journey.

You will work across brand, social, D2C, performance marketing, CRM, product and retail, while getting the opportunity to own Zouk's voice, lead a copy team and build systems that enable high-quality communication at scale.

* Do you have experience working on performance marketing and/or CRM copy, including ad hooks, headlines, CTAs, email, WhatsApp or retention communication?
* Do you have experience leading, mentoring, reviewing or managing the work of other copywriters/content writers?

Digital Marketing Strategy:

* Develop, implement, and optimize the overall digital marketing strategy, ensuring it aligns with business objectives and brand goals.
* Identify new opportunities and trends in digital and social media marketing to keep the brand at the forefront of the industry.

* Implement and oversee SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings, traffic, and visibility.
* Optimize website content, landing pages, and digital assets to enhance user experience and SEO performance.
* Conduct keyword research and analysis to ensure that content and campaigns are optimized for the right search terms.

Performance Analysis \& Reporting:

* Regularly track and analyze key metrics, including website traffic, lead generation, conversion rates, and social media engagement.
* Provide monthly performance reports to management, highlighting successes, insights, and areas for improvement.
* Use A/B testing, heat maps, and other tools to optimize campaigns for better performance and user engagement.

Email Marketing:

* Plan, execute, and optimize email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and promotional blasts.
* Segment email lists and ensure personalization and relevant messaging to improve open rates and conversions.

Team Collaboration \& Management:

* Work closely with other marketing team members, designers, copywriters, and external agencies to execute digital campaigns.
* Lead and mentor junior team members and interns to foster a creative and high\-performing marketing team.
* Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices, bringing fresh ideas to the team and helping the organization stay ahead of digital marketing trends.

Brand Monitoring \& Crisis Management:

* Track brand sentiment and online reputation, addressing potential issues in real\-time.
* Work closely with PR and customer service teams to manage crises or negative feedback across social media channels.

Deluxe Veneers is expanding its showroom presence with a **newly opening showroom in Thane**. We are looking for an experienced **Showroom Sales Manager** from the **plywood, laminates, veneers, surface, interior products or allied building\-material industry** to lead showroom sales and customer relationships.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day\-to\-day operations and sales of the Thane showroom.
* Achieve monthly and annual showroom sales targets.
* Handle walk\-in customers and understand their product requirements.
* Develop business through architects, interior designers, contractors, dealers and builders.
* Generate leads and convert enquiries into sales.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Coordinate quotations, orders, dispatches and customer follow\-ups.
* Maintain showroom presentation, product displays and samples.
* Monitor competitor activities and market trends.
* Prepare regular sales and customer\-visit reports.
* Lead and motivate showroom sales staff.

* Graduate with **5–8 years of relevant sales experience**.
* **Industry experience is preferred from:**
* Plywood
* Laminates
* Veneers
* Surface materials
* Decorative surfaces
* Interior products
* Building materials
* Furniture / allied interior\-material industries
* Strong showroom sales and business\-development experience.
* Good knowledge of the **Thane and surrounding market**.
* Candidates **residing in Thane or nearby areas will be preferred**.
* Good network with architects, interior designers, contractors, dealers and builders will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and customer\-handling skills.
* Target\-oriented with the ability to independently manage showroom sales.

We are looking for a high\-ownership Branch Manager to lead our Mumbai office end\-to\-end. This is not a purely administrative role — we need someone who can drive student enrolments, build a high\-performing counselling team, and position our branch as the go\-to overseas education destination in Mumbai. \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

1\. BRANCH OPERATIONS \& P\&L MANAGEMENT

* Own the branch's monthly, quarterly, and annual enrolment targets
* Monitor and manage branch\-level revenue, expenses, and profitability
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for leadership
* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations including office administration, vendor coordination, and compliance
* Implement SOPs for all branch processes — lead management, counselling, documentation, and visa filing

2\. STUDENT COUNSELLING \& CONVERSION

* Oversee the end\-to\-end student journey from first enquiry to visa approval
* Step in personally on high\-value or complex student cases to guide counsellors
* Drive walk\-in conversion rates by monitoring counsellor performance at every stage of the funnel
* Ensure students receive accurate, ethical, and comprehensive guidance on universities, courses, intakes, scholarships, and visa requirements
* Resolve student escalations and complaints swiftly and professionally
* Stay updated on destination\-specific changes (UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe, Ireland, New Zealand) including visa policy, tuition fee changes, and intake patterns

3\. TEAM LEADERSHIP \& PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

* Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of student counsellors, application processors, and front desk staff
* Set individual KPIs and conduct regular one\-on\-ones and performance reviews
* Coach and mentor counsellors to improve their product knowledge, communication skills, and conversion ability
* Identify training needs and coordinate with the central team to deliver upskilling sessions
* Build a positive, target\-driven branch culture with low attrition
* Handle team conflicts, attendance, and HR\-related matters at the branch level

4\. LEAD GENERATION \& BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

* Drive footfall and walk\-ins through local marketing, referral programs, and community engagement
* Build and nurture relationships with schools, junior colleges, degree colleges, coaching centres, and education influencers in Mumbai
* Organise and participate in education fairs, seminars, school visits, and open days
* Coordinate with the digital/marketing team to run local campaigns and follow up on inbound digital leads
* Develop B2B tie\-ups with feeder institutions to create a consistent pipeline of students
* Track competitor activity in Mumbai and share market intelligence with leadership

5\. UNIVERSITY \& PARTNER RELATIONS

* Liaise with university representatives and attend university roadshows and training sessions
* Maintain strong relationships with university admission teams to benefit students on borderline applications
* Ensure the branch team is up\-to\-date on partner university programs, entry requirements, and promotions
* Coordinate with university partners for events, webinars, and on\-campus visits

6\. QUALITY \& COMPLIANCE

* Ensure all student files, applications, and documentation meet company and partner university standards
* Monitor the accuracy of applications submitted and minimise rejection rates
* Ensure the branch adheres to all internal compliance guidelines and data protection standards
* Conduct regular audits of student files and counselling notes

7\. REPORTING \& STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

* Submit weekly performance dashboards to the regional/central team
* Participate in monthly business review calls with senior leadership
* Highlight risks, blockers, and resource needs proactively
* Represent the branch's perspective constructively and advocate for your team's needs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

* 5–8 years of experience in the overseas education industry
* Minimum 2 years in a branch leadership or team management role
* Proven record of consistently achieving enrolment targets
* Deep knowledge of at least 3–4 study destinations (UK, USA, Canada, Australia preferred)
* Strong people manager — someone who leads by example and earns team trust
* Entrepreneurial mindset — treats the branch like their own business
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi (Marathi is a plus)
* Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Excel, and basic reporting
* Currently based in Mumbai or willing to relocate immediately

WHAT WE OFFER

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

* Compensation open to discussion based on experience and fit
* Performance\-based incentives linked to branch targets
* High\-autonomy role with direct access to senior leadership
* A fast\-growing company with a strong support infrastructure
* Opportunities for career growth as the company expands nationally
